metadata.title: PRISM / PhantomLens: Physics-grounded interpretable deepfake detection — reproducibility package
metadata.description: Code, identity-disjoint splits, extracted feature CSVs, and all result tables for the Scientific Reports paper on physics-grounded, interpretable deepfake detection. All numbers are leakage-free (identity-disjoint official FaceForensics++ split), deterministic (seed 42), and regenerable from the deposited feature CSVs without re-downloading the license-gated source videos. Raw videos and derived face crops are NOT included (dataset license); see DATASET_ACCESS.md.
